explicitMultiagent.conclusion: The isolated schema is explicit, preserves 23 tasks and 48 conversations, and is usable by the least-privilege application role.

options.name: 独立 arforge_ma 数据库
benefits: Multi-agent migrations and load are isolated from Session/Core tables.
Least-privilege grants can be scoped to only three multi-agent schema tables.
A future multi-agent repair does not require touching the main product schema.
costs: Backups and restore drills must cover both databases.
The current arforge_ma grants must be repaired by an administrator.
ARFORGE_MULTIAGENT_DB_URL must be persisted explicitly instead of relying on derived naming.
requiredAdminActions: Inspect row counts in arforge_ma before changing grants.
Grant CONNECT, public schema USAGE, and DML on multiagent_tasks and multiagent_conversations to arforge_app.
Verify the application role can read and write both tables but still cannot create schemas.
Apply the Workflow Graph Core migration to the main arforge database.
Back up and restore-drill both arforge and arforge_ma.

options.name: 全部共用 arforge 主库
benefits: One database backup contains Session, memory, learning, workflow, and multi-agent state.
The existing main-database multi-agent tables are already writable by arforge_app.
No second application database privilege repair is needed.
costs: Core and Alembic migrations share one public schema and require stricter collision controls.
The existing arforge_ma database must be inspected and then retained, archived, or removed by a separate explicit decision.
A multi-agent-heavy workload shares maintenance and failure scope with the main product.
requiredAdminActions: Inspect arforge_ma row counts before deciding whether it contains data that must be imported.
Persist ARFORGE_MULTIAGENT_DB_URL equal to the main arforge URL.
Apply the Workflow Graph Core migration to arforge.
Run the complete application-role privilege audit and a single-database restore drill.

options.name: 回退到本地 SQLite
benefits: No PostgreSQL administrator is needed for a single local profile.
costs: Conflicts with the requested private PostgreSQL product direction.
Removes the server/team durability and cross-process database contract.
Would require a new migration and acceptance scope.

recommendedDecision.reason: The project already models multi-agent persistence as an isolated database and its schema exists. Repairing least-privilege grants is lower risk than merging two migration authorities into the main public schema.

rules: Provide it only in the current process or the private user environment.
Do not paste it into source, chat output, command history, logs, or documentation.
The Workflow Graph migration URL must target the arforge database on the same PostgreSQL server.
Option 1 additionally needs administrator access to arforge_ma for grant repair and verification.
